rubric.shared_vocabulary: The two texts use several of the same distinctive words or names (not just common words).
rubric.shared_topic: Both texts are broadly about the same kind of thing (e.g. a trickster animal, a ghost, a clever servant).
rubric.shared_plot: Both texts contain at least one recognisably shared narrative event or sequence (e.g. an impossible task solved with animal help).
rubric.different_outcome: Despite any similarity, the outcome, moral or the role of a main character clearly differs.
rubric.insufficient_evidence: You cannot judge from what you read (too short, fragmentary, or unclear).
